## Current build and progress

The **[November 15 progress report](progress.qmd)** covers the printed setup, CAD iterations, received parts, Hall/ADC tests, MCU–FPGA SPI work, electromagnet PWM tests, and design-review preparation.

| Document | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Progress report](progress.qmd) | Work since the proposal, results, and next integration steps |
| [System design](design.qmd) | FPGA ADC acquisition, separate MCU SPI readout, and PWM signal paths |
| [MCU](mcu.qmd) / [FPGA](fpga.qmd) / [Hardware](hardware.qmd) | Current subsystem implementation and remaining checks |
| [Updated schematic](assets/progress-report/maglev_schematic.docx) | Hall/ADC wiring and electromagnet drive, dated November 15 |
| [Diagram bundle](assets/progress-report/maglev_diagrams.zip) | System and internal diagrams, schematic sheets, and editable SVGs |
| [Results](results.qmd) | Dated bench observations and earlier software evidence |

The latest schematic and bench sources supersede proposal assumptions about MCU-owned ADC/DMA acquisition and installed support hardware.

## Current bench source

- [MCU 16-bit SPI receiver](simple_byte/main.c)
- [FPGA top](fpga/pwm_sweeper/top.sv) and [pin constraints](fpga/pwm_sweeper/pins.pcf)
- [ADC SPI interface](fpga/pwm_sweeper/adc_spi.sv)
- [16-bit word sender](fpga/pwm_sweeper/spi_byte_tx.sv)
- [Duty sweep](fpga/pwm_sweeper/sweep_8bit.sv), [PWM](fpga/pwm_sweeper/pwm.sv), and [counter](fpga/pwm_sweeper/counter.sv)

The [one-byte test guide](simple_byte/README.md), [original FPGA sender](simple_byte/spi_byte.sv), and [testbench](simple_byte/tb_spi_byte.sv) preserve the earlier fixed-pattern experiment. The guide's embedded MCU listing is 8-bit; the current downloadable MCU source is the later 16-bit experiment.
